verdict: Spotify grew revenue 14% to €4.8B (about $5.5B) as Premium subscribers reached 300 million, and a 33.4% gross margin turned that into €655M of operating income and €545M of net income.

kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.note: vs a year ago (+15% in constant currency)

segments.name: Premium
segments.note: Subscriptions — the paid tier. Revenue per subscriber rose as price increases flowed through.

segments.name: Ad-Supported
segments.note: The free tier, funded by advertising. A funnel that converts listeners into subscribers.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Building the app, recommendation systems and new formats like video podcasts and audiobooks.

opex.name: General & administrative
opex.note: Running the company day to day.

follow100Note: Premium subscriptions are about $91 of every $100 Spotify takes in; the free tier is the funnel, not the engine. Rows add up with a small rounding difference.
otherDetail: Finance items netted a gain — interest earned on Spotify's large cash pile (€86M as reported), minus finance costs (€21M as reported).
footerNote: Spotify reports in euros under IFRS. Dollar figures are converted at €1 = $1.1421 (USD:Euro 0.8756 at Jun 30, 2026, the rate in Spotify's own release), with small rounding adjustments so the converted lines foot exactly. As reported: revenue €4,777M · gross profit €1,596M · operating income €655M · net income €545M.

takeaways.title: Subscribers carry the business
takeaways.text: Premium subscribers grew 9% to 300 million — 7 million net adds, ahead of guidance — and Premium revenue rose 15%. Total monthly users reached 777 million, up 12%.

takeaways.title: Margins keep expanding
takeaways.text: Gross margin reached 33.4%, up from 31.5% a year ago, and operating income rose 61% to €655M — ahead of guidance, helped by lower social charges (payroll taxes tied to the share price).

takeaways.title: Cash generation is now routine
takeaways.text: Free cash flow was €797M in the quarter and €3.3B over the last twelve months. For Q3 Spotify guided to €5.0B of revenue and €670M of operating income.
